facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: improvement notice - critical safeguard at P-4105

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-4105, M-4105 and PT-4105 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. P-4105 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 16 February 2011 a regulatory notice was issued concerning P-4105, M-4105 and PT-4105 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following an intrusive maintenance task.
